universal_proof_basis: cut support sets depend only on whether each class has appeared and whether it appears again
middle occurrences change neither left-support nor right-support
deleting middle occurrences preserves the set of support-state pairs and layout width
every endpoint layout expands to arbitrary larger multiplicities by inserting middle copies between first and last occurrences without creating a new support state
therefore path-width depends on multiplicity a_j only through min(a_j,2)
algorithmic_corollary: With k distinct geometric subspace classes, exact path-width for the repeated-class restriction is computable by enumerating precedence-respecting event orders of at most 2k retained occurrences and evaluating subspace sum/intersection dimensions; this is f(k)*poly(input) and does not contradict general representable-matroid path-width NP-hardness.
